attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2546/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 21 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives no life at all — only that she was British, the year 383 in its heading, and part of her relics at the church of her name in Cologne. The year comes from the heading alone, which is why `basis` is `traditional`; no coordinate is proposed. Nothing in the corpus answers to the name. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
